connector.name: Tachibot MCP
connector.registryDescription: Multi-model AI orchestration with 31 tools, YAML workflows, and 5 token-optimized profiles.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package tachibot-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bypawel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
